decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9495. Series context: trend strength 0.9907 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.181); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.626.
